newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli guard stabbed 20 times in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Israeli guard stabbed 20 times in West Bank.

text.p: An Israeli guard was stabbed 20 times and seriously wounded early on Tuesday at a Jewish settlement near the West Bank town of Hebron in an apparent Palestinian guerrilla attack, military sources said.

The sources said the attack happened at the Omarim settlement near Hebron, a volatile town split between Israeli and Palestinian rule. The guard was rushed to a hospital in Beersheba, southern Israel. Soldiers launched a search for the assailants.
